source_text: Haec dum intra se cogitaret sanctissima Virgo, talibus Archangelus sermonibus disceptationem eius solvit, dicens ad ipsam: Spiritus Sanctus superveniet in te, et virtus Altissimi obumbrabit tibi. Ideo et quod nascetur ex te sanctum, vocabitur Filius Dei. Et ne timeas Maria: non enim ut metum tibi incuterem, adveni; sed ut metus materiam a te repellerem. Ne timeas Maria: invenisti enim gratiam apud Deum. Ne diiudices gratiam secundum naturam. Legibus enim naturae, se subiici gratia non patitur.
thought_title: Do not fear, grace is not measured by nature
orientation: Gabriel answers Marys question by saying the Holy Spirit will come upon her and the child will be called Son of God.
pass_a_gloss: While the most holy Virgin was thinking these things within herself, the Archangel resolved her questioning with such words, saying to her: Holy Spirit will come upon you, and power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also what will be born from you holy, will be called Son of God. And do not fear Mary: for I came not in order that I might strike fear into you; but in order that I might drive the matter of fear away from you. Do not fear Mary: for you have found grace before God. Do not judge grace according to nature. For grace does not allow itself to be subjected to the laws of nature.

choices.why: solvit with accusative means undoing a mental knot, and context is Mary weighing the greeting, not a legal dispute
tibi is dative of person affected by overshadowing, kept as direct you in literal English per glossary sense
materia here is cause or material for fear, not physical stuff

choices.english: Do not judge grace according to nature
choices.why: ne with subjunctive is prohibition, secundum naturam is the standard of measurement forbidden
rejected: Do not distinguish grace by nature

pass_b_english: While the most holy Virgin was turning these things over within herself, the Archangel resolved her questioning with words such as these. He said to her: "The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you (Luke 1:35). And so the holy child to be born of you will also be called Son of God (Luke 1:35). And do not fear, Mary, for I have come not to strike fear into you but to drive the cause of fear away from you. Do not fear, Mary, for you have found favor with God (Luke 1:30). Do not judge grace according to nature, for grace does not allow itself to be made subject to the laws of nature."
